name: browser-sniffer-tauri
description: Tauri sniffer bootstrap: the fetch/XHR/console shim that emits captured network activity as structured payloads on the single multiplexed `BRIDGE_EVENT` Tauri channel (with `_tag` as the dispatch discriminator), plus an in-page top bar for the sniffer webview. The bundled IIFE is consumed by browser-sniffer-tauri-rust via include_str!.

scripts.build: vp pack && node scripts/build-tauri-bootstrap.mts && node scripts/build-native-bootstrap.mts
scripts.test: node scripts/build-tauri-bootstrap.mts && node scripts/build-native-bootstrap.mts && vp test
